question: A tree gains 50 kg as it grows. Where does most of that mass come from? Explain.
answers: Plants get their food from the soil through the roots
The plant mass comes from minerals and water in the soil
Plants eat soil, that is why soil goes down in the pot
Most of the tree came from the ground it grew in
Roots suck up food from the soil and that becomes the wood
Photosynthesis: carbon dioxide from the air is built into sugars, so most mass is from air
The carbon in the wood came from CO2 in the air during photosynthesis
Leaves take in CO2 and make glucose, which becomes cellulose — so mainly air
Sunlight gives the plant energy and it turns the light into wood
The mass comes from sunlight being stored in the plant
Light energy becomes the plant material as it grows
